lessons: This is the second attempt to fail review on the same gaps. The prior lessons were in the prompt but mostly unaddressed. Before finishing, map each acceptance criterion to a named test and confirm the test exists.

Bug: compose_daemon_storm_producer's reconciliation loop calls record() for every Box message, including storm-breaker:P0 reports. Move the STORM_BREAKER_ORIGIN check into the shared record() closure, or skip those messages in the loop.

The no-recursion test is vacuous: Box signatures are sha256 hex, so startswith('storm-breaker') always passes. Run two sessions and assert no storm_occurrence carries the P0 report's message.signature. Also assert the report stays at reports==1.

Criterion 1: drive squatch.__main__ run/drain through _RestartRunner with a fake pipeline. Enqueue through real harvest second-problem and verification-attribution Boxes, including one built before binding. Calling compose_daemon_storm_producer directly does not count.
Criterion 1 cleanup: on normal exit and on an exception raised inside the session, assert the lock is released, the restart timer is shut down and the occurrence binding is reset.

Criterion 2: assert trip_id equals the sha256 of the canonical [signature, first, crossing] JSON and is stable across replay. Changing any one component must change it. Test expiry at exactly now-WINDOW and just inside it on the same signature.

Criterion 3: write separate tests for a rolled journal segment before recovery, for a trip signal already present with the report missing (repairs to exactly 1 report), and for a resolved report (no new report, reports stays 1).

Criterion 4: while holding Lockfile, box.main(['ingest', ...]) must return 2 with the refusal and paved-road text and leave the Box unchanged. After a trip, run real drain work and assert dispatch proceeds with no control_hold event.
The full `uv run pytest -q` run never finished inside the 30s output window. Run it in the background or in chunks, and record its exit status before marking the attempt ok.
reason: A lessons-fed retry repeated the same unmet criteria, plus a real recursion bug and a vacuous test, and finished in 20m of a 75m budget. The ticket is feasible but needs more capability to cover it thoroughly.
